description: Use this when the user asks for a sound effect, click, notification, jingle, audio, music, song or soundtrack, or mentions Moose Tracker: returns usage notes. No arguments gives a short index (workflow, limits, formats, next steps); topic opens one section: limits, styles, recipes, presets, mtl, instrument, effects, modulation, drums, loops, formats, sfx, examples, errors, genres, generators, samples, search, not_supported, workflow, volume, mix, sounds; q searches presets and the sample library. Song text up to 256 KB; one audio file holds about 8 min as WAV, longer as Ogg or Opus (exact seconds per format in the index). Tool list 1.3.0. Schema 2d7abb8b.

category.description: topic=samples: only this category (drums, keys, pads, ...)

genre.description: topic=samples: only packs for this genre

q.description: Search word, example id, role for topic=instrument; for samples also category=X genre=Y
